characters.name: 深夜经典守护者
characters.tagline: 夜再深，熟悉的那一口总在。
characters.design: A huge handsome classic sesame hamburger head with elegant half-lidded small eyes and knowing smile; a tiny golden-yellow tailcoat body, dark-blue short star-lined cape and large rounded red shoes. Like the reference but more balanced appealing face. Clear golden arches logo embroidered on the outer red shoe.
